#nullable enable
using System.Numerics;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using CobolCS.Runtime;
namespace CobolCS.Generated;
/// <summary>固定入力・応答を精度を失わず再構築し、業務観測値を比較します。探索や IR は不要です。</summary>
public static class Characterization
{
    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions Options = CreateOptions();
    private static JsonSerializerOptions CreateOptions()
    {
        var options = new JsonSerializerOptions { MaxDepth = 128, UnmappedMemberHandling = JsonUnmappedMemberHandling.Disallow };
        options.Converters.Add(new NumericConverter());
        options.Converters.Add(new OptionalFactory());
        options.Converters.Add(new ContractFactory());
        options.MakeReadOnly(populateMissingResolver: true);
        return options;
    }
    public static T Read<T>(string json) => JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(json, Options) ?? throw new ArgumentException("Null replay value");
    public static string Serialize<T>(T value) => Normalize(JsonSerializer.Serialize(value, Options));
    public static string Normalize(string json)
    {
        JsonNode? Sort(JsonNode? node) => node is JsonObject obj ? new JsonObject(obj.OrderBy(p => p.Key, StringComparer.Ordinal).Select(p => KeyValuePair.Create(p.Key, Sort(p.Value)))) : node is JsonArray array ? new JsonArray(array.Select(Sort).ToArray()) : node?.DeepClone();
        return Sort(JsonNode.Parse(json))?.ToJsonString() ?? "null";
    }
    public static string Request<T>(T request)
    {
        var json = JsonNode.Parse(Serialize(request))!.AsObject();
        if (json["Source"] is JsonObject source)
        {
            json["PassingModes"] = source["PassingModes"]?.DeepClone();
            json["Operation"] = source["Operation"]?.DeepClone();
        }
        json.Remove("Source");
        return Normalize(json.ToJsonString());
    }
    public static string Observation<T>(T result) where T : notnull
    {
        var type = result.GetType();
        object? Get(string name) => type.GetProperty(name)!.GetValue(result);
        var dependencies = new JsonArray();
        foreach (var trace in (IReadOnlyList<DependencyTrace>)Get("DependencyTrace")!)
        {
            var request = trace.GetType().GetProperty("Request")?.GetValue(trace);
            dependencies.Add(new JsonObject { ["status"] = trace.StatusCode, ["outcome"] = trace.Outcome.ToString(), ["implementation"] = trace.Implementation, ["request"] = request == null ? null : JsonNode.Parse(Request(request)) });
        }
        return Normalize(new JsonObject
        {
            ["Snapshot"] = JsonSerializer.SerializeToNode(Get("Snapshot"), Options),
            ["Arguments"] = JsonSerializer.SerializeToNode(Get("Arguments"), Options),
            ["Display"] = JsonSerializer.SerializeToNode(Get("Display"), Options),
            ["Termination"] = Get("Termination")!.ToString(),
            ["Dependencies"] = dependencies,
            ["HasNoOpCalls"] = (bool)Get("HasNoOpCalls")!,
            ["CallStubMode"] = Get("CallStubMode")!.ToString(),
        }.ToJsonString());
    }
    private sealed class NumericConverter : JsonConverter<Number>
    {
        public override Number Read(ref Utf8JsonReader reader, Type type, JsonSerializerOptions options)
        {
            if (reader.TokenType == JsonTokenType.String) return CobolValue.Numeric(reader.GetString()!);
            using var value = JsonDocument.ParseValue(ref reader);
            return new Number(BigInteger.Parse(value.RootElement.GetProperty("numerator").GetString()!, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), BigInteger.Parse(value.RootElement.GetProperty("denominator").GetString()!, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        }
        public override void Write(Utf8JsonWriter writer, Number value, JsonSerializerOptions options)
        {
            writer.WriteStartObject();
            writer.WriteString("numerator", value.Numerator.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            writer.WriteString("denominator", value.Denominator.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            writer.WriteEndObject();
        }
    }
    private sealed class ContractFactory : JsonConverterFactory
    {
        public override bool CanConvert(Type type) => type.Namespace == "CobolCS.Generated" && (type.Name.EndsWith("Response", StringComparison.Ordinal) || (type.Name.Contains("Group", StringComparison.Ordinal) && type.Name.EndsWith("Snapshot", StringComparison.Ordinal)));
        public override JsonConverter CreateConverter(Type type, JsonSerializerOptions options) => (JsonConverter)Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(ContractConverter<>).MakeGenericType(type))!;
    }
    private sealed class ContractConverter<T> : JsonConverter<T>
    {
        public override T Read(ref Utf8JsonReader reader, Type type, JsonSerializerOptions options)
        {
            using var document = JsonDocument.ParseValue(ref reader);
            var constructor = type.GetConstructors().OrderByDescending(c => c.GetParameters().Count(p => p.ParameterType.IsGenericType && p.ParameterType.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(Optional<>))).First();
            var parameters = constructor.GetParameters();
            foreach (var property in document.RootElement.EnumerateObject())
                if (!parameters.Any(p => p.Name == property.Name)) throw new JsonException("Unknown contract member " + property.Name);
            var values = parameters.Select(p => document.RootElement.TryGetProperty(p.Name!, out var value) ? JsonSerializer.Deserialize(value.GetRawText(), p.ParameterType, options) : p.HasDefaultValue ? p.ParameterType.IsValueType ? Activator.CreateInstance(p.ParameterType) : p.DefaultValue : throw new JsonException("Missing contract member " + p.Name)).ToArray();
            try { return (T)constructor.Invoke(values); }
            catch (System.Reflection.TargetInvocationException error) when (error.InnerException != null) { throw new ArgumentException("Invalid contract: " + error.InnerException.Message, error.InnerException); }
        }
        public override void Write(Utf8JsonWriter writer, T value, JsonSerializerOptions options)
        {
            writer.WriteStartObject();
            foreach (var property in typeof(T).GetProperties())
            {
                writer.WritePropertyName(property.Name);
                JsonSerializer.Serialize(writer, property.GetValue(value), property.PropertyType, options);
            }
            writer.WriteEndObject();
        }
    }
    private sealed class OptionalFactory : JsonConverterFactory
    {
        public override bool CanConvert(Type type) => type.IsGenericType && type.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(Optional<>);
        public override JsonConverter CreateConverter(Type type, JsonSerializerOptions options) => (JsonConverter)Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(OptionalConverter<>).MakeGenericType(type.GetGenericArguments()))!;
    }
    private sealed class OptionalConverter<T> : JsonConverter<Optional<T>>
    {
        public override bool HandleNull => true;
        public override Optional<T> Read(ref Utf8JsonReader reader, Type type, JsonSerializerOptions options) => reader.TokenType == JsonTokenType.Null ? default : new(JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(ref reader, options)!);
        public override void Write(Utf8JsonWriter writer, Optional<T> value, JsonSerializerOptions options)
        {
            if (value.HasValue) JsonSerializer.Serialize(writer, value.Value, options);
            else writer.WriteNullValue();
        }
    }
